definitions.explanation: An island that is remote and separated from the mainland or other islands. Often evokes images of isolation, remoteness, or being cut off from civilization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{太平洋|たいへいよう}→太平洋：09680_taiheiyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧{孤島|ことう}。
examples.english: A solitary island floating in the Pacific Ocean.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}ら→彼ら：01802_karera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{孤島|ことう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{数年間|すうねんかん}⟦{生活|せいかつ}した→生活する：01839_seikatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: They lived on an isolated island for several years.

examples.japanese: {孤島|ことう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{残|のこ}された→取り残す：10028_torinokosu⟧⟦{冒険家|ぼうけんか}→冒険家：20564_boukenka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{自力|じりき}→自力：08513_jiriki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧いかだ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{脱出|だっしゅつ}した→脱出する：26829_dasshutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The adventurer, stranded on a remote island, built a raft by himself and escaped.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {孤|こ} (solitary) and {島|とう} (island). Common in literature, adventure stories, and descriptions of remote locations. Also used figuratively to describe extreme isolation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶海|ぜっかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{孤島|ことう}: a remote island in the middle of the ocean
- {孤島|ことう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{漂着|ひょうちゃく}→漂着：16933_hyouchaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be washed ashore on an isolated island
- {孤島|ことう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{残|のこ}される→取り残す：10028_torinokosu⟧: to be stranded on a remote island
